news.h: RB Josh Jacobs not anticipating missing more time despite additional allegations
news.d: Packers running back Josh Jacobs said he's operating under the assumption that he won't have to sit out any more games than the six he already missed while on the NFL commissioner's exempt list despite the release of additional allegations against him.

news.h: Packers sticking with RB Josh Jacobs despite latest abuse allegations
news.d: Packers coach Matt LaFleur says the team is sticking with RB Josh Jacobs despite new allegations of abuse levied by multiple women in addition to a May incident that led to his arrest.

news.h: Additional allegations against Packers' Josh Jacobs 'unsupported,' attorneys say
news.d: The attorneys for Green Bay's Josh Jacobs called the additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse "unsupported and stale allegations" in a statement on Sunday, two days after a police department in Wisconsin released records related to his arrest.

news.h: NFL to review additional allegations against Packers RB Josh Jacobs
news.d: The NFL said it will look into additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse by Packers RB Josh Jacobs that were revealed as part of a public records release from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department.

news.h: Records show 3 other women accused reporters abuse after arrest
news.d: Three other women contacted police to detail allegations of abuse against Packers RB Josh Jacobs following his May arrest for an altercation with his then-girlfriend.
